# Legacy reverse arithmetic evidence

`sources.json` records source SHA-256 and exact original offset/hash for each
sparse part. Tests reconstruct a 2 MiB image filled with `0xff`, then overlay
these unchanged source spans. Parts retain the full saved-register function,
mode coefficient consumers, media-state inventory regions, literal pools, and
native ARM division dispatcher. Firmware names and hashes never select grammar.

Positive sources are BN11 (`5c01c1fd…`) and a distinct NB50 build (`a344e289…`).
The early `c88a6901…` source is deliberately negative: its reverse arithmetic
substrate is present, but the independently required zero/one mode coefficient
consumer grammar is not established. Absence of this grammar is not proof that
its firmware has no mode field or that its hardware cannot read UHD.

The contract establishes arithmetic inputs, native continuations and balanced
saved-LR behavior. It does not establish mode entry/exit producers or authorize
installing a reverse conversion.
